title: What If Your CRUSH Became a Zombie and Only Wanted to Bite You?
tags: what if you were a zombie
description:
Your crush is a zombie 23 hours a day. Every day at exactly 12:14 PM she turns human for one hour — and every day she remembers a little less. Gus has six days to get her to the cure before she forgets him completely. There's just one problem: she bit him on day one, and he never turned.

Two questions for the comments:
1) Garage, or patrol? One word.
2) Your zombie only bites people who were awful to you. Who does yours bite first?


Real facts in this episode: the zombie-ant fungus (bites at noon), where the word "zombie" comes from, the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, and why smell skips the filter.

#zombie #crush #animation #ifverse #animatedstory #storytime
